answer: Bindings are kept in gale, verified in violet, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, and thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the meadow check. That bill is paid per identity, so 123 aliases cost 316 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
